releaseNotes: Smart Search Deep OCR is now faster without rebuilding the index: on capable phones it processes two OCR files at a time while keeping the warmed local PaddleOCR model and a limited two-thread inference setting. Lower-core devices remain sequential automatically. Pause waits for only the current small OCR batch, completed files remain checkpointed in SQLite, unchanged files are not processed again, and the existing two-stage PDF/document-photo filtering remains unchanged. Existing Search by Name, Search Content, Connect to PC, Transfer Status, reminders, sounds, and previous Smart Life behavior are preserved.
